title: Stream crossing · channel and banks

exceptions.label: An approved forest stewardship plan with an intended result or strategy for fish habitat in a fisheries sensitive watershed, as the section pertains to cumulative hydrological effects on fish habitat there (§12.31)
exceptions.decidedBy: The minister, approving the forest stewardship plan
evidence: The order establishing the fisheries sensitive watershed
The plan’s result or strategy for fish habitat in the watershed (§8.1) and the area it applies to
The plan’s approval

exceptions.label: A ministerial exemption for a forest operations plan holder, where the plan addresses the matter at least as effectively (§4.51)
evidence: The forest operations plan’s requirement or measure for the matter
The minister’s exemption

exceptions.label: The departure is necessary to allow the person to conform to the Workers Compensation Act and its regulations (§2(3))
evidence: The Workers Compensation Act requirement, and why meeting it needs the departure

finding: An authorized person who builds a stream crossing as part of a road or an access structure must locate, build and use it so that it protects the stream channel and banks immediately above and below it and mitigates disturbance to them at the crossing. On these answers this crossing does not.

actions.description: Relocate or redesign the crossing, or its construction and use, to protect the channel and banks above and below it and to mitigate disturbance at it, and record how.

finding: An authorized person who carries out a primary forest activity must conduct it at a time and in a manner that is unlikely to harm fish or destroy, damage or harmfully alter fish habitat. On these answers the work at this crossing is not.

actions.description: Time the work outside the periods when fish there are most at risk, and change its manner (isolating the work site, controlling sediment), and record both.

title: Crossing structure · sound and safe

exceptions.label: The departure is necessary to allow the person to conform to the Workers Compensation Act and its regulations (§2(3))
evidence: The Workers Compensation Act requirement, and why meeting it needs the departure

finding: A person who constructs or maintains a road must ensure that the road and its bridges, culverts, fords and other structures are structurally sound and safe for use by industrial users. On these answers this crossing’s structure is not.

actions.description: Design, build or repair the structure to be sound and safe for industrial users, and record its design and inspection.

title: Bridge · design and fabrication

exceptions.label: The departure is necessary to allow the person to conform to the Workers Compensation Act and its regulations (§2(3))
evidence: The Workers Compensation Act requirement, and why meeting it needs the departure

finding: A person who builds a bridge for a road must ensure that its design and fabrication meet or exceed CAN/CSA-S6 and the Canadian Foundation Engineering Manual as they apply when the design or fabrication is done, and take into account logging trucks with unbalanced loads and off-centre driving. On these answers this bridge’s do not.

actions.description: Have the bridge designed and fabricated to those standards and loads, and record the design and who prepared it.
